displayTitle: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon
synopsis: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon is the first entry in Mad Cave Studios Tales from the Outer Rim series Like most kids his age, Luke Skywalker longs for adventure, but growing up on the distant desert planet of Tatooine, he feels more than a little stuck. And with Luke's best friend, Biggs Darklighter, already daydreaming about leaving to enroll in the Imperial Academy, Luke feels like he's sinking into a Sarlacc Pit! So he decides it's time to embark on an unforgettable summer adventure of his own and brave the legendary Beggar's Canyon! Some Tatooine locals say Beggar's Canyon is haunted by terrifying spirits. Others say it's home to ferocious beasts. Luke, Biggs, and their friends are determined to conquer this mysterious abyss. But will they discover the truth behind the tall tales, or be lost in the harsh desert sands forever?!
title: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon
